name: skills_exposed
description: Read which skills are currently exposed in the skill slots (root scope, observed default), replayed in the logged-in page context.

execution.expression: async () => { const r=await fetch('https://www.doubao.com/alice/office/skills/get_exposed?version_code=20800&language=zh&device_platform=web&doubao_device_platform=desktop',{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json'},credentials:'include',body:JSON.stringify({scope:{scope_type:1,scope_id:''}})}); const b=await r.json().catch(()=>null); const d=b&&b.data; const slots=(d&&Array.isArray(d.slots)?d.slots:[]).slice(0,20).map(s=>({slot:Number.isInteger(s.slot)?s.slot:null,skillId:String(s.skill_id||'').slice(0,120),skillName:String(s.skill_name||'').slice(0,160),skillDisplayName:String(s.skill_display_name||'').slice(0,160),skillType:Number.isInteger(s.skill_type)?s.skill_type:null,source:Number.isInteger(s.source)?s.source:null})); return {httpStatus:r.status,code:Number.isInteger(b&&b.code)?b.code:null,hasFilled:d?d.has_filled===true:null,isDefault:d?d.is_default===true:null,updatedAt:d&&Number.isFinite(d.updated_at)?d.updated_at:null,maxVisibleSlotCount:d&&d.config&&Number.isInteger(d.config.max_visible_slot_count)?d.config.max_visible_slot_count:null,slotCount:slots.length,slots}; }
